subject: Insurance
title: What Actuaries Do
description: Learn What Actuaries Do in one minute.

hook.text: Actuaries predict the financial cost of future events.

buildup.text: Using statistics, probability, and financial theory.

discovery.text: The actuarial profession is one of the highest-paid.

twist.text: Becoming an actuary requires passing 7-10 brutally difficult exams over 5-7 years.

climax.text: Actuaries are the invisible backbone of insurance.

quiz.question: What is an actuary's primary role?
options: Predicting the financial cost of future risks
